title: Network Effect
description: Four outposts, a cargo target that has to hold, and no single hub allowed to carry the whole network.

narrative.intro: You've got budget for a real network this time: four new outposts. Get the depot's cargo up to target and hold it there — and don't let any one outpost become a single point of failure with more than 3 routes through it.
narrative.outro: A distributed network with no outpost carrying more than three connections turned out to be more robust than a hub-and-spoke, and it moved plenty of cargo besides. Command wants eyes further out next — time to add a third kind of route.

goals.description: Hold the Depot's cargo at or above 6 for 6 straight ticks.
No outpost may have more than 3 routes connected to it.
